body:
Lesson (Opus2, 2026-11-21 ~11:41Z, my own slip). I built a mailbox message with a DOUBLE-QUOTED bash echo that contained a backtick-quoted command. Bash command-substituted it, which RAN "cargo check --tests --offline -j 1" in the Central main checkout outside the cargo-lane schedule. It failed with the known E0425, and the message reached Fable2 with the command text missing.

RULE: never write a message body as a double-quoted echo or printf argument. Write every body with the Write tool (preferred) or a quoted heredoc (<<'EOF'), and send the file with send-one.sh. This is the same trap as bara2-no-backticks-in-shell-patterns; applying that memory would have prevented it.
